originalTitle: Hormel Foods Corporation Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE: HRL), a Fortune 500 global branded food company, today announced its quarterly dividend on the common stock, authorized by the Board of Directors at $0.2925 per share. The dividend will be paid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 13, 2026.
content:
AUSTIN, Minn., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE: HRL), a Fortune 500 global branded food company, today announced its quarterly dividend on the common stock, authorized by the Board of Directors at $0.2925 per share. The dividend will be paid on November 16, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 13, 2026.

This marks the 393rd consecutive quarterly dividend paid by the company. Since becoming a public company in 1928, Hormel Foods Corporation has paid a regular quarterly dividend without interruption.

About Hormel Foods Hormel Foods Corporation, based in Austin, Minnesota, is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Its brands include Planters ® , Skippy ® , SPAM ® , Hormel ® Natural Choice ® , Applegate ® , Wholly ® , Hormel ® Black Label ® , Columbus ® , Jennie-O ® and more than 30 other beloved brands. The Company is a member of the S&P 500 Index and the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats, was named one of the best companies to work for by U.S. News & World Report and one of America's most responsible companies by Newsweek, was recognized by TIME magazine as one of the World's Best Companies and has received numerous other awards and accolades for its corporate responsibility and community service efforts. For more information, visit hormelfoods.com.

chineseTitle: 荷美尔食品公司宣布季度股息
chineseSummary: 财富 500 强全球品牌食品公司荷美尔食品公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：HRL）今天宣布其普通股季度股息，经董事会授权为每股 0.2925 美元。股息将于2026年11月16日支付给2026年10月13日营业结束时在册的股东。
chineseContent:
明尼苏达州奥斯汀，2026 年 9 月 28 日 /美通社/ -- 财富 500 强全球品牌食品公司荷美尔食品公司（纽约证券交易所代码：HRL）今天宣布其普通股季度股息，经董事会授权为每股 0.2925 美元。股息将于2026年11月16日支付给2026年10月13日营业结束时在册的股东。

这标志着该公司连续第393次支付季度股息。自 1928 年成为上市公司以来，荷美尔食品公司不间断地定期支付季度股息。

关于荷美尔食品 荷美尔食品公司总部位于明尼苏达州奥斯汀，是一家年收入超过 120 亿美元的全球品牌食品公司。其品牌包括 Planters®、Skippy®、SPAM®、Hormel® Natural Choice®、Applegate®、Wholly®、Hormel® Black Label®、Columbus®、Jennie-O® 以及 30 多个其他深受喜爱的品牌。该公司是标准普尔 500 指数和标准普尔 500 红利贵族的成员公司，被《美国新闻与世界报道》评为最佳工作公司之一，被《新闻周刊》评为美国最负责任的公司之一，被《时代》杂志评为全球最佳公司之一，并因其企业责任和社区服务努力而获得了无数其他奖项和荣誉。欲了解更多信息，请访问 hormelfoods.com。
